claims: Firm order backlog at March 31, 2026 was approximately 62.7 billion dollars, up 11.5 billion dollars from fourth-quarter 2025; 24.8 billion dollars was not expected to be filled within twelve months.
Dealer inventory increased 2.0 billion dollars in Q1 2026 versus 0.1 billion dollars in Q1 2025, and management said inventory changes contributed to sales growth.
Q1 operating margin was 17.7% versus 18.1% a year earlier and adjusted operating margin was 18.0% versus 18.3%; higher volume and price were partly offset by manufacturing costs including tariffs.
Management expected approximately 700 million dollars of tariff costs in Q2 and 2.2 to 2.4 billion dollars for full-year 2026.
Q1 2026 sales and revenues were 17.4 billion dollars, up 22% year over year.
Q1 2026 adjusted EPS was 5.54 dollars and enterprise operating cash flow was 1.9 billion dollars.
Management described order activity as robust and backlog as a record.
The board increased the quarterly dividend 8% to 1.63 dollars per share and reiterated an intent to return substantially all MP&E free cash flow over time.
The official quarterly-results index exposed Q1 2026 materials but displayed the Q2 2026 release and presentation as unavailable at the research cutoff.
